MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.

2. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Only memorise without using the language

3. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.

4. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.

5. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.

6. When practising Reading for Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Fluency.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Understanding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.

2. A — Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.

4. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.

5. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.

6. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Fluency.

7. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading for Fluency; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
